selection.ownership: Text S.A. (formerly LiveChat Software S.A.; KRS 0000290756, Wrocław, WSE:TXT) operates HelpDesk.com as its ticketing product. This is not Freshdesk, Zendesk, or a generic helpdesk alias. Polish ownership of a global edition is not EXCLUDE.

research.searchCoverage: Official HelpDesk.com API authentication (Personal Access Token as HTTP Basic with account_id username), licenses/tickets/agents/teams GET docs, Text S.A. product identity distinct from Freshdesk/Zendesk, SOC 2 Type I attestation, and dated incident search (HelpDesk.com + LiveChat + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. LiveChat widget phishing abuse is not a HelpDesk.com backend breach. No unresolved HelpDesk.com compromise found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.summary: Cofense reported phishers abusing customer-configured LiveChat widgets on lc.chat to impersonate brands. That is third-party misuse of the LiveChat product, not a disclosed HelpDesk.com API or backend compromise.

adaptations: Pinned credential validator uses GET /v1/licenses; native healthcheck prefers GET /v1/agents as a cheap authenticated account read that is also a defined upstream action.
Native Basic auth uses http.auth.basic with accountId as username and the personal access token as password.
Official docs advise a User-Agent because intermediary services may block requests without it; native omits the upstream user-agent like other recipes.
OAuth2 authorization-code is documented for production apps but is not implemented; this recipe uses the documented PAT Basic path.

Admits optional scalar filters status, silo, pageSize, order, and sortBy. Array filters (teamIDs[], tagIDs[]), hasAssignee Y/N encoding, and next/prev cursor objects are omitted because the native query template cannot match the pinned source encodings.
Returns the raw ticket array under data; source-computed cursors from x-total-pages/x-total-results headers are omitted.
ticketId is URL-encoded as a path segment. Returns raw HelpDesk JSON under data instead of wrapping {ticket}.
